speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: Lowering the turbines would substantially reduce the risk of collisions with migratory birds.

speaker: FEATHERWINGS
text: From the perspective of bird protection, this is an effective solution.

speaker: TOURISM BOARD
text: Lower turbines would also reduce the visual impact of the wind park from the coastline.

speaker: TOURISM BOARD
text: This would be considerably better for the coastal landscape and tourism than highly visible coloured blades.

speaker: ENERGY MINISTER
text: However, the reduction in turbine height would significantly reduce the amount of energy each turbine can produce.

speaker: ENERGY MINISTER
text: This would make it considerably more difficult to meet our renewable energy and climate targets.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: The measure therefore provides strong protection for SDG 15 and benefits tourism, but creates a substantial conflict with SDGs 7 and 13.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Arcadia must consider whether the environmental and tourism benefits justify the significant loss of energy production.
